exampleBody.prompt: How should I think about payments roles? Please check if any of the following companies are mentioned: . If any of these companies are mentioned, provide the latest news articles and ensure that the links to these articles are clickable.

promptOnlyFields.preferred_sources: Joined into 'Preferred News Sources: ...'. Not passed to NewsAPI.
promptOnlyFields.time_frame: Written as 'Time Frame: ...'. Not passed as NewsAPI from/to. Also a React dependency of the dead news prefetch.
promptOnlyFields.selectedCompany: Consider the company: {value}. This is the companies-table name, not a second NewsAPI query.

liveDataInPrompt.favorites: Loaded with Favorites.query.filter_by(user_id=user_id), not from the POST body.
liveDataInPrompt.news: fetch_news_for_company(name, desired_article_count=3) per favorite. HTML anchors of title and url.
liveDataInPrompt.selectedReport: Self HTTP GET http://localhost:5555/api/search?q=... then exact title match.

clientRender: res.data.response passed through formatResponse, then dangerouslySetInnerHTML
